title: B2B Lead & MarTech Pixel Enricher (v21.6)
description: Deep MarTech stack audit (GTM macro unpacking, sGTM, GA4 duplicate detection, EU Consent Mode v2), B2B contact classification, Decision-Maker discovery, and GDPR/UWG §7 compliance.

domains.sectionDescription: Provide target company domains or URLs and select whether you want the full 96-column engineering dataset or the 21-column SDR/CRM compact view.
domains.title: Target Domains / URLs
domains.description: List of company domains or URLs to enrich (e.g., 'intertop.ua', 'https://www.notino.de').

outputView.title: Output Dataset View
outputView.description: Choose 'full_audit' for all 96 technical & compliance columns, or 'sdr_compact' for a clean 21-column CRM-ready table (includes pain_point_detected and predicted_dm_email).
enumTitles: SDR / CRM Compact Outbound View (21 Columns)

defaultPhoneRegion.title: Default Phone Region Fallback
defaultPhoneRegion.description: ISO 2-letter country code used when a domain TLD is generic (.com, .io, .store) and language hints are ambiguous.

serperApiKey.sectionCaption: 2. Deep DM & Email Verification Keys (Optional — Recommended for 9/10 Outbound Readiness)
serperApiKey.sectionDescription: Connect Serper.dev (Google SERP X-Ray) to locate CMO / Head of Marketing LinkedIn profiles on e-commerce sites, and Reoon / MillionVerifier to validate predicted DM emails to 'mailbox_verified_deliverable'.
serperApiKey.title: Serper.dev API Key (LinkedIn CMO X-Ray)
serperApiKey.description: Optional API key from serper.dev. Automatically finds CMO / Head of Digital / Marketing Director on LinkedIn when the website only lists legal CEOs or no executives.

reoonApiKey.title: Reoon Email Verifier API Key
reoonApiKey.description: Optional API key from reoon.com. Verifies generated DM email hypotheses (e.g., i.shevkoplyas@sendpulse.ua) in real time and promotes safe addresses to best_email.

millionVerifierApiKey.title: MillionVerifier API Key
millionVerifierApiKey.description: Optional API key from millionverifier.com (alternative to Reoon for live SMTP/API verification of predicted DM emails).

forceFreshScan.sectionCaption: 3. Cache Freshness, Anti-Bot WAF & Webhook Integration
forceFreshScan.sectionDescription: Control cache TTL (prevent stale 73-day snapshots), force aggressive Playwright rendering on strict WAF domains, or push results directly to n8n / Make / Clay / HubSpot / Slack.
forceFreshScan.title: Force 100% Fresh Live Scan (Ignore Cache)
forceFreshScan.description: If enabled, completely bypasses prior cached snapshots in Key-Value Store and performs a strictly live scan today.

maxCacheAgeDays.title: Maximum Cache Age (Days)
maxCacheAgeDays.description: Maximum allowed age (in days) for fallback cache snapshots. Set to 0 to disable cache reads, or 14-30 to prevent stale 70+ day snapshots.

bypassHopelessWaf.title: Force Playwright on Strict WAF Domains (Bypass Hopeless List)
bypassHopelessWaf.description: If enabled, forces Playwright browser rendering even on known strict DataDome/Cloudflare domains (coolblue.nl, zalando.de, otto.de, grammarly.com). Recommended when using Residential proxies.

webhookUrl.title: Outbound Webhook URL (n8n / Make / Clay / CRM / Slack)
webhookUrl.description: Optional HTTPS URL. When the run finishes, the Actor automatically sends a JSON POST payload containing run telemetry and enriched lead records.

scanContactPages.sectionDescription: Fine-tune subpage crawling, GTM container unpacking, concurrency, and Apify Proxy settings.
scanContactPages.title: Crawl Contact, About & Impressum Subpages
scanContactPages.description: Automatically discovers and scans /contact, /about, /team, /b2b, and /impressum pages for executive names and B2B emails.

unpackGtmContainers.title: Unpack Raw GTM Container JS (gtm.js)
unpackGtmContainers.description: Downloads and inspects raw Google Tag Manager container code to detect hidden GA4 measurement IDs, ad pixels, and duplicate tagging.

maxConcurrency.title: Max HTTP Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of parallel fast HTTP workers (curl_cffi).

maxBrowserConcurrency.title: Max Playwright Browser Concurrency
maxBrowserConcurrency.description: Maximum number of parallel headless browser contexts for JS rendering.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy settings. Residential proxies are automatically used for WAF escalation if available on your account.
